decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program has a dedicated page and is central to mental health, so visible commitment and accumulated costs make dropping unlikely.
The carpentry workshop has its own page and builds on established production know-how, creating sunk costs and public commitment that favor persisting.
Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the firm's core mental health services, and though its website presence is modest, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal unlikely.
Counseling for senior living is shown on the home page and is central to eldercare, reflecting high public commitment that strongly discourages dropping.
The retail shop leverages the sheltered workshop and production know-how, but its weaker prominence means commitment is moderate, so persistence is likely though less certain.

Meal delivery for seniors is close to the firm's core eldercare direction but has only a website mention and was launched recently, so sunk costs and public commitment are lower than for more prominent products.
